title: IDOR exposes other customers' invoices
notes:
IDOR on GET /api/invoices/{id}. Logged in as priya.k@acme-shop.in (regular customer) I can read invoices of other customers by changing the numeric id.
Invoice 1042 is mine. Invoices 1043 and 1044 returned other customers' names, addresses and totals.
There is no rate limiting on enumeration.

evidence.name: invoice-1043.txt
evidence.text:
GET /api/invoices/1043 HTTP/1.1
Host: shop.acme.test
Cookie: session=REDACTED-BY-TESTER

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{"id":1043,"customer":"Rahul M","email":"rahul.m@acme-shop.in","total":"4200.00"}
